description: Reusable Copilot prompt templates used to build and enhance the accessible Sudoku game.

prompts.title: Create the Sudoku board HTML
prompts.template: Generate semantic, accessible HTML for a 9x9 Sudoku board with a difficulty selector, game controls, and descriptive labels for every cell.

prompts.title: Style the Sudoku board
prompts.template: Add responsive CSS for a square Sudoku board with distinct 3x3 regions, visible keyboard focus states, high-contrast colors, dark mode support, and reduced-motion support.

prompts.title: Generate a playable puzzle
prompts.template: Implement JavaScript that generates a randomized Sudoku puzzle with a verified unique solution, supports Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties, and locks the prefilled cells.

prompts.title: Add core gameplay
prompts.template: Implement move validation, incorrect-cell feedback, a hint system, timer tracking, accessible live status messages, and local-storage save and restore behavior.

prompts.title: Add leaderboard support
prompts.template: Add a hint button that reveals and locks a valid number, then implement a local-storage top-10 leaderboard containing player names, completion times, difficulty levels, and hint counts.

prompts.title: Add advanced gameplay tools
prompts.template: Add used-number tracking, accessible Note Mode for candidate numbers, and a visual solver-step animation without changing the current puzzle values.
